verdict.rationale: 1Password's own docs say it stores one-time passwords for two-step verification and gives quick access to them. A long-time user reports their mother uses its QR-code 2FA capture, which supports the scan-and-generate flow. First-party docs in the pack do not describe the QR scanning step or show codes being generated right after setup, and one user calls two-factor setup buggy, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of QR-code scanning to add a TOTP secret, evidence of immediate code generation after the scan, and independent hands-on corroboration that setup is reliable.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
